metadata.title: Ursa Major II - Reproducing the observed properties through tidal disruption

notes: No eligible individual stars are identified. The paper studies the dwarf spheroidal galaxy Ursa Major II (UMa II), not an individual star; it discusses tidally unbound model/member stars collectively but gives no individual stellar identifiers. Its use of “unbound stars” refers to stars unbound from the simulated UMa II core or in tidal tails, not to stars explicitly identified as unbound from the Milky Way in their present-day state (e.g. T:p1-b6, T:p11-b3, T:p16-b1). UMa II itself is modeled on a bound Milky Way orbit (T:p3-b0), so it does not qualify as a Galactic unbound candidate.
